notes: built by CAPS (bench/ff/make_opls_des_doherty2018.py) from the paper and its SI only; each term cites its table
charges as the SI prints them, built for a +-0.8 e ion scaling: choline +0.8, chloride -0.8, every HBD neutral

choline chloride's charges and Lennard-Jones terms refitted to reline's ND/EPSR structure; the HBDs' non-bonded terms tuned against choline chloride: for DES mixtures only, not the pure HBD liquids (paper p. 9984)
HBD bonds, bends and torsions as the SI's Tables S5 and S6 print them (OPLS-AA's, ethylene glycol's torsions from Szefczyk & Cordeiro 2011); choline's from OPLS-2009IL (Table S2, S3)
ethylene glycol: Table S6 lists only OH-CG-CG-OH and CG-CG-OH-HO (Szefczyk & Cordeiro's); its hydrogen torsions H-C-C-H, H-C-C-O and H-C-O-H are zero

rows X-c-X-X of Tables S3 and S6 read as impropers on c, V2 / 2 (1 - cos 2 phi), every triple of its neighbours (four on choline's N); the all-zero X-CM-X-X and X-CT-X-X left out; no improper for phenol's ring or levulinic acid's carbonyls (none listed)
levulinic acid's bend HO-CB-CZ (Table S5) read as OH-CB-CZ; ethylene glycol's OPLS-AA class names in Table S5 (CT, HC) and the O called OH in Table S6 and Scheme S2 read as Table S4's CG, HG, OG
urea's HC (cis to O) and HT (trans) have identical terms; CAPS's rules assign HT to every urea H, and the H-N-H bend (HC-N-HT, Table S5) is matched as H?-N-H?
ion_charge_scale 0.8: an ion's types add up to its formal charge times 0.8 (the paper's scaling)
geometric mixing, 1-4 pairs scaled by 0.5, cut-off 16 A (the paper's GROMACS set-up, PME)
masses: standard atomic masses (the paper gives none)
